blocks.text: 分享关于 Perplexity Computer 中自我提升技能的新研究。Brain 已经会维护一个关于你工作的知识 wiki，现在还会根据你过去的会话为你编写和更新智能体技能。一个改进智能体会读取完整的会话轨迹（工具调用、推理、结果），找出反复出现的模式，并且只有在证据充分时才会提出新技能或更新。每位用户都会获得的内置技能，在任何变更上线前都要经过失败场景的配对回放和工程师审核。在生产流量上进行的一项为期 8 周的随机测试中，72.9% 的用户至少获得了一项新的个人技能，而手动添加技能的用户仅占 6.5%。工具调用失败率下降了 11%，不满意对话线程下降了 7.6%，成本或延迟没有可测量的变化。

blocks.text: Sharing new research on self-improving skills in Perplexity Computer. Brain, which already maintains a knowledge wiki about your work, now also writes and updates agent skills for you based on your past sessions. An improvement agent reads the full session trajectories (tool calls, reasoning, results), finds recurring patterns, and only proposes a new skill or an update when there’s enough evidence. Built-in skills that every user gets go through paired replay on failure scenarios and engineer review before any change goes live. In an 8-week randomized test on production traffic, 72.9% of users got at least one new personal skill vs 6.5% who added one manually. Tool call failures dropped 11% and dissatisfied threads dropped 7.6%, with no measurable change in cost or latency.
